Suggest a maximum speed for each track from the data

Source: R/track_suggest_max_speed.R
track_suggest_max_speed.Rd

This function suggests, for each track, a maximum speed that separates the speeds of plausible steps from those of outliers, by looking for a break in the distribution of the (log) speeds of the steps between consecutive events. The suggestion can be used as max_speed in event_flag_mcconnell() and tt_clean_mcconnell(). It is a wrapper around move2utils::mt_suggest_speed_cap(), applied to each track separately, which requires the suggested package move2utils (install it with remotes::install_github("move2universe/move2utils")).

Usage

track_suggest_max_speed(
  x,
  method = c("auto", "entropy", "gap"),
  threshold = NULL,
  units = as_units("m/s")
)

Arguments

x

A move2 object.

method

The method used to find the break, one of "auto" (the default; an entropy-based method, falling back to a broken-stick method validated with a dip test), "entropy" or "gap". See move2utils::mt_suggest_speed_cap().

threshold

A numeric value passed to the method used to find the break. The default NULL uses the default of move2utils.

units

The units of the returned speeds, as a units object (e.g. as_units("km/h")). Defaults to m/s.

Value

A units vector with the suggested maximum speed for each track (in the same order as the tracks in the metadata, see show_meta()), named by track id, with NA for the tracks for which no break was found.

Details

The suggestion is purely data-driven: check it against what is known about the species (see also move2utils::v_phys_estimate()). No suggestion (NA) is given when no break is found, e.g. when a track has no outliers, or when it has fewer than 10 steps with a positive speed. Events without a location are ignored. x must be ordered by time within each track (see tt_order_time()), and have a geographic CRS or a projected CRS in metres (move2utils takes projected coordinates to be in metres).

To inspect the distribution of speeds of a track, or to obtain a single suggestion pooling all tracks, use move2utils::mt_suggest_speed_cap() directly.

Examples

track_suggest_max_speed(example_tt)
#> Units: [m/s]
#>  a  b  c 
#> NA NA NA
